Eve (Marketing): FYI weekly KPI digest: launches dashboard flags a 30% drop in webinar-to-MQL conversion this week. https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-launches :thinking_face:
Noah (Growth): hmm. impressions up, clicks steady, but CPL jumped. Any specific campaign dip?
Aria (Analytics): drilling down  the `utm_campaign=april-launch` cohort shows conversions down 34%. raw leads show many with `referrer=unknown`.
Eve (Marketing): we pushed refreshed launch posts across socials yesterday morning. Could be tagging mismatch?
Noah (Growth): did the social team switch to the shortlink provider? we switched providers last month for better tracking.
Aria (Analytics): checking redirect logs. shortlink service returned 302 -> `https://redwood.app/s/launch` but lost the `utm_campaign` param when the link contained an encoded fragment.
DevBot: ALERT: shortlink-service reported `param_strip` error 2026-04-10T09:13:21Z for domain x.co
Noah (Growth): that would cause campaign traffic to fall back to organic in attribution and inflate direct/organic conversions.
Harper (Sales): heads up, Sales saw a drop in campaign-tagged leads in the CRM yesterday. We're seeing a backlog of untagged leads in the SDR queue.
Eve (Marketing): can we estimate how many leads affected and surface an adjusted KPI so leadership isn't looking at misleading CPL?
Aria (Analytics): rough calc: ~1.6k visits through the shortlink between 09:10-09:45, with a conversion rate of 4% historically -> ~64 MQLs likely misattributed. I can create `adjusted_webinar_mqls` that infers utm via shortlink logs + timestamp/landing path.
Noah (Growth): please add an annotation on the dashboard for the 09:10-09:45 window and show both raw and adjusted series.
Eve (Marketing): action items: 1) Aria to backfill adjusted metric + tag inferred leads (ETA 3h), 2) Ops to patch shortlink param handling, 3) Growth to pause new social posts using x.co until fixed.
ops-bot: Task created #OPS-2421: "shortlink preserve querystring". Assigned to Riley (Ops). Due 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC.
DevBot: quick mitigation idea: append `?utm_campaign=april-launch` server-side when referrer matches x.co. Will open PR.
Aria (Analytics): once backfill is done I'll post a comparison table in this thread and update the weekly KPI deck.
Harper (Sales): please tag the inferred leads in CRM so SDRs can prioritize outreach; otherwise we risk losing pipeline.
Eve (Marketing): thanks team. I'll hold off sending the exec note until we reconcile adjusted numbers. :handshake:
